parent_hypothesis: earnings_continuation_A_v1 (different horizon -- NOT a retest of the falsified same-day hypothesis)
research_stage: orthogonal second-engine candidate characterization, following the research-governance cleanup's item-14 priority (PEAD is the highest-priority next research direction). Holdout budget: 0 -- this is characterization on already-viewed history, not a fresh validation test.

integrity.historical_holdout_status: CONSUMED; no date in historical storage may be presented as fresh validation
integrity.forward_validation: Prospective paper track ONLY if falsification criteria are met and only after a separate, explicit subsequent instruction. Not built here. Does not modify V3.2 or paper-trading Tracks 1-3.

relationship_to_falsified_prior_work: earnings_continuation_A_v1 (sub-hypothesis A, same-day open-to-close continuation) and its A' amendment (realistic open-to-next-close) were both FALSIFIED, and A' additionally showed regime decay (H2 full-sample t=3.14 -> 2020+ subperiod t=0.22). This is preserved, not re-litigated. PEAD sub-hypothesis B tests a DIFFERENT, non-overlapping forward window -- close[announcement day] to close[t+5]/[t+10]/[t+20] -- using the same earnings_gap sign as a cheap, already-available proxy for earnings surprise direction (no new data purchase). If B also collapses in 2020+, that is independent corroborating evidence for the same regime-decay finding, not proof B was never viable; if B survives where A/A' did not, that is informative about WHERE in time the earnings-information-diffusion edge lives (announcement-day pricing vs multi-day drift), since the two sub-hypotheses test different economic claims (same-day efficiency vs multi-day underreaction) despite sharing a signal proxy.
economic_hypothesis: After earnings announcements, stocks continue to drift in the direction of their earnings surprise over the subsequent 5-20 trading days, driven by slow information diffusion across market participants (sell-side revision lags, gradual institutional position adjustment, delayed retail processing). The initial gap direction predicts multi-day drift direction even after the announcement-day return has been fully realized and removed from the measurement window.

mechanism.claim: Market underreaction to earnings news persists for days because information diffuses slowly across investor types.
predicted_cross_sectional_pattern: Stronger for larger earnings surprises (larger gap)
Stronger for smaller, less-covered firms (slower diffusion)
Stronger in periods of lower market attention (less crowded)

signal_definition.formula: earnings_gap = (open[t] - close[t-1]) / close[t-1], where t = earnings announcement anchor trading day -- IDENTICAL formula and event-anchoring methodology to earnings_continuation_A_v1 (SF1 datekey, dimension='ARQ', anchored to that date if a trading session else the next session). Reused verbatim, not redefined.
signal_definition.pead_direction: sign(earnings_gap): positive gap (beat) -> PEAD signal = +1 (go long); negative gap (miss) -> PEAD signal = -1 (avoid/short).

forward_return_window_locked.critical_distinction: Returns are measured starting from the CLOSE of the announcement day (not the open, not the same-day open-to-close move), so there is zero overlap with the announcement-day return already tested and falsified in sub-hypotheses A/A'.
forward_return_window_locked.H2_10day: close[t] -> close[t+10] (NEW -- not computed by earnings_continuation_A_v1, which only had H3=5-day/H4=20-day; a 10-day horizon is added specifically for this study)
forward_return_window_locked.reuse_note: H1 (5-day) and H3 (20-day) use the identical close-to-close return construction already implemented in strategies/earnings_continuation.py's build_features() (return_H3 and return_H4 there). Only the 10-day horizon and the sequential-earnings exclusion below are new computations.

universe.source: Full Sharadar common stocks, identical filters to V3.2/earnings_continuation_A_v1: firstpricedate<=signal date<=lastpricedate (or no lastpricedate), excl. Financial Services/Real Estate/Healthcare Fama sectors, price>=$1, trailing 20-day median dollar volume>=$500k (pre-event), >=252 trading days history.
universe.earnings_event_definition: SF1 datekey (fundamentals.date, dimension='ARQ') within the anchor-day convention reused from earnings_continuation_A_v1 -- identical to the definition used throughout this project's earnings research.
universe.sequential_earnings_exclusion_NEW: Exclude an earnings event if it falls within 5 trading days (by the ticker's own trading-session index) of that same ticker's immediately PRIOR earnings event in this dataset. This prevents one ticker's overlapping/compressed earnings cycle (e.g. a restatement, late 10-Q, or unusually tight cadence) from contaminating the 5/10/20-day forward-return window with a second, different earnings event's gap. A ticker's very first observed event is never excluded by this rule (no prior event to compare against).

cost_model.rationale: 10bps entry + 10bps exit, same per-event total as the weekly composite's round-trip assumption. Lower turnover than the weekly composite (positions held 5-20 days, not 7) is noted qualitatively; annualized cost is reported per-event-per-year using the measured events-per-stock-per-year rate (~4 expected, confirmed or corrected by the actual coverage count).

regime_check_2020_plus_MANDATORY.rule: Run and report BEFORE any full characterization. Pre-2020: 2001-01-01 to 2019-12-31. Post-2020: 2020-01-01 to 2024-12-31. This repeats, for PEAD specifically, the diagnostic that found earnings_continuation_A' decayed from full-sample t=3.14 to 2020+ t=0.22.
regime_check_2020_plus_MANDATORY.stop_condition: If ALL THREE horizons (H1/H2/H3) show 2020+ subperiod t < 1.0 at the primary (2%) threshold: STOP here and report HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT. Do not proceed to the full characterization table, factor regression, leave-one-crisis-out, or size analysis.

leave_one_crisis_out_MANDATORY.rule: Per research-governance item 9 (V2/research/canonical/research_state.json), rerun the frozen primary-threshold/H2(10-day) measurement excluding one crisis episode at a time. Episode windows are REUSED VERBATIM from the already-established project definitions (same windows used in V2/reports/crisis_robustness/20260911T162542Z/ and v31_deepening_q2q3) -- not redefined here: dot-com/2001-2002 (2001-05-25 to 2003-05-09), GFC/2008-2009 (2007-07-13 to 2010-04-09), COVID/2020 (2019-12-20 to 2020-06-05), 2022 bear (2021-11-12 to 2023-03-03). Events whose anchor date falls inside a window are excluded for that run only.
leave_one_crisis_out_MANDATORY.reporting: full sample, each of the four exclusions: N events, spread %/yr, HAC t-stat, sign.

factor_model.specification: FF5 + UMD (6-factor), reusing strategies/ibs_conditioning._factor_regression and its FACTOR_COLUMNS constant (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA, Mom) exactly as used throughout this project -- UMD is the 'Mom' column and is ALWAYS included, never run without it for this study.
factor_model.applies_to: H1(5d) and H2(10d) daily per-event-day spread and long-leg series at the primary threshold (best horizon reported per the brief's output format; both computed regardless).
factor_model.key_diagnostic: UMD loading on the long leg. If alpha disappears once UMD is included, the 'PEAD' finding is statistically indistinguishable from buying recent momentum winners, not a distinct post-earnings-drift effect.

size_subgroups.method: Reuse strategies/earnings_continuation.market_cap_subgroups() methodology (marketcap terciles, pre-event) applied to the H1(5d)/H2(10d) return columns at the primary threshold.
size_subgroups.prediction_to_check: Theory predicts PEAD is stronger in smaller, less-covered firms. Reported as observed, not assumed.

falsification_criteria.VIABLE: H1 or H2 long-leg t > 2.0 AND 2020+ subperiod t > 1.5 (on the same horizon) AND alpha survives UMD inclusion (not pure momentum replication) AND leave-one-crisis-out verdict is ROBUST or PARTIALLY_ROBUST.
falsification_criteria.HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT: Full-sample significant (t>2.0 on at least one horizon) BUT 2020+ subperiod t < 1.0 on that same horizon -- effect existed historically but appears gone now.
falsification_criteria.FALSIFIED: H1, H2, AND H3 all t < 1.5 at the primary (2%) threshold, OR UMD absorbs essentially all of the alpha (long-leg alpha_tstat collapses to non-significance once Mom/UMD is added vs a no-UMD check).
falsification_criteria.MARGINAL: H2 or H3 significant but H1 is not, OR 2020+ subperiod t falls between 1.0 and 1.5.

multiple_testing_note: Three thresholds (1%/2%/3%) times three horizons (5/10/20-day) are preregistered and ALL reported regardless of outcome -- no cherry-picking. The 2% threshold is the preregistered primary result, selected before any computation, matching earnings_continuation_A_v1's own primary-threshold convention for direct comparability.
constraints: Preregistration (this file) committed before any return computation begins.
The 2020+ regime check runs FIRST and is reported before the full characterization table. If it is fatal (HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT on all three horizons), this study stops there.
Leave-one-crisis-out is mandatory (research-governance item 9) and uses the existing, already-established crisis window definitions verbatim -- not redefined after seeing results.
UMD (the 'Mom' factor) is always included in the factor regression. No FF5-without-UMD run is reported as a standalone result for PEAD.
This study does not conflate with or re-test earnings_continuation_A/A' (already falsified) -- it measures a non-overlapping forward window.
All three preregistered thresholds are reported regardless of result; none are cherry-picked or dropped from the output.
If VIABLE: a paper-track operational description is written, but the track itself is NOT built, no holdout data is consumed, and V3.2 / paper-trading Tracks 1-3 are not modified.
Do not optimize thresholds, horizons, or exclusion rules after seeing results.
deliverables: 2020+ regime check (H1/H2/H3, full-sample/pre-2020/post-2020, at the primary threshold) -- run and reported first
If not fatal: full characterization table across all 3 thresholds x 3 horizons (long spread, t-stat, avoid spread, t-stat, N events)
Factor regression (FF5+UMD) on the primary-threshold long leg and spread, for H1 and H2
Size (marketcap tercile) analysis at the primary threshold for H1/H2
Falsification verdict: VIABLE / HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT / FALSIFIED / MARGINAL
If VIABLE: an operational description of what a PEAD paper-trading track would look like (not built)
stop_condition: Report results and wait for instruction. Do not build a PEAD paper track, consume holdout data, or modify V3.2/Tracks 1-3, regardless of verdict.
